description: Aggregate federal spending grouped by a specific dimension: NAICS industry code, PSC product/service code, awarding or funding agency or subagency, CFDA assistance program, recipient, federal account, or Disaster Emergency Fund Code (DEF). Returns top items with obligation amounts — useful for trend and breakdown analysis. Filter by keyword, award type, agency, recipient, NAICS code, Assistance Listing, PSC, DEF code, place of performance or recipient location, or date range. federal_account and defc amounts are whole transaction obligations, counted under every federal account or DEF code the award carries, so rows overlap and never sum to a total; on defc, filters.def_codes selects awards but the rows still list every code those awards carry. Chain NAICS, PSC, CFDA, and DEF codes back into these filters, into usaspending_search_awards filters, or into usaspending_autocomplete_filters lookups; a federal_account code (AGENCY-MAIN, e.g. 047-4534) opens in usaspending_get_federal_account. Agency rows carry agency_slug, which opens the agency in usaspending_get_agency — on a subagency row, its parent department. recipient_duns rows carry recipient_id, which opens the recipient profile in usaspending_get_recipient, and uei.

category.description: Breakdown dimension: naics (industry), psc (product/service code), awarding_agency, awarding_subagency, funding_agency, funding_subagency, cfda (assistance programs), recipient_duns (recipients), federal_account (appropriations accounts; code is the AGENCY-MAIN account code usaspending_get_federal_account takes), or defc (Disaster Emergency Fund Codes; code is the DEF code the def_codes filters take). federal_account and defc amounts are whole transaction obligations, counted under every account or DEF code the award carries, so rows overlap and never sum to a total; on defc, filters.def_codes selects awards but the rows still list every code those awards carry.

filters.description: Optional filters to scope the aggregation

agency_name.description: Awarding top-tier or sub-tier agency name — use the matched name from usaspending_autocomplete_filters type=awarding_agency; use toptier_name to select the whole parent department. A sub-tier name shared by several parents matches under all parents.

assistance_listings.description: Filter by Assistance Listing (CFDA) program numbers, e.g. ["15.507"]: two digits, a dot, then three digits or capital letters (11.67A). Matches an award when any of its listings equals one of these exactly; several values match any of them. A matching award's primary listing can differ from the one requested, and amounts cover the whole award, not that listing's share. Only assistance awards (grants, direct payments, loans, other assistance) carry listings, so a call whose award types are all contracts or IDVs — including a contract default — is rejected as assistance_listings_type_mismatch. Use usaspending_autocomplete_filters type=cfda to look up numbers.

def_codes.description: Filter by Disaster Emergency Fund Codes (DEF), e.g. ["Z"], or ["L", "M", "N", "O", "P"] for COVID-19: 1–3 letters or digits, sent uppercased — the codes usaspending_disaster_spending takes and usaspending_get_agency lists. Matches awards of any type funded under any of these codes. Amounts cover the whole matching award, not the share funded by the code, and DEF-filtered totals can be negative. An unknown code is rejected with the list of codes USAspending accepts.

items.description: Disaster Emergency Fund Code, e.g. Z or L

keywords.description: Full-text keyword filters; each effective term needs at least three characters, including significant whitespace

naics_codes.description: NAICS codes: canonical 2, 4, or 6 digits; recognized ASCII integer aliases normalize whitespace, plus, leading zeros and digit underscores; unclassified spellings remain provider-validated

place_of_performance_location.description: Filter by place of performance — where the work is done. Takes codes, not place names — resolve a state or county name to its code with usaspending_autocomplete_filters type=location. Blank fields are ignored, and an all-blank object is no location filter. The location sent is echoed as applied_location.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (e.g., USA); USA when omitted. A US territory code — PRI, GUM, VIR, ASM, MNP — is sent as USA with the territory as state.

county.description: US county FIPS code: 3 digits with state (049 with state NM), or the 5-digit state + county code (35049, Santa Fe County, NM), whose first two digits set the state — the form usaspending_spending_by_geography county rows carry as shape_code.

state.description: Under USA (the default): a US state, DC, territory, freely associated state, or armed-forces code as a 2-letter postal code (NM, PR, FM, AE) or 2-digit FIPS code (35). Under another country: that country's own 2-letter subdivision code (ON with CAN).

psc_codes.description: Filter by Product and Service Codes (PSC), e.g. ["Y1NE"]: 1–4 letters or digits, sent uppercased. A shorter code covers every code under it ("Y1" covers "Y1NE"); several values match any of them. Only contracts and IDVs carry a PSC, so a call whose award types are all assistance types is rejected as psc_codes_type_mismatch, and pairing psc_codes with assistance_listings matches nothing, since no award carries both. Use usaspending_autocomplete_filters type=psc to look up codes.

items.description: Product and Service Code or prefix, e.g. Y1NE or Y1

recipient_id.description: recipient_id from usaspending_search_recipients: hexadecimal 8-4-4-4-12 hash plus uppercase -P, -C, or -R; hash letters normalize to lowercase; empty is unset

recipient_location.description: Filter by recipient location — where the recipient is based, which can differ from where the work is done. Takes codes, not place names — resolve a state or county name to its code with usaspending_autocomplete_filters type=location. Blank fields are ignored, and an all-blank object is no location filter. The location sent is echoed as applied_recipient_location.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (e.g., USA); USA when omitted. A US territory code — PRI, GUM, VIR, ASM, MNP — is sent as USA with the territory as state.

county.description: US county FIPS code: 3 digits with state (049 with state NM), or the 5-digit state + county code (35049, Santa Fe County, NM), whose first two digits set the state — the form usaspending_spending_by_geography county rows carry as shape_code.

state.description: Under USA (the default): a US state, DC, territory, freely associated state, or armed-forces code as a 2-letter postal code (NM, PR, FM, AE) or 2-digit FIPS code (35). Under another country: that country's own 2-letter subdivision code (ON with CAN).

anyOf.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD; month and day may be unpadded

time_period_end.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD). Given alone, the window starts at 2007-10-01, the earliest searchable date.

anyOf.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD; month and day may be unpadded

time_period_start.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD), 2007-10-01 or later. Given alone, the window runs through today (UTC).

limit.description: Items per page. Default 10, at most 100 per call.

name: usaspending_spending_by_category

applied_location.description: Place of performance location sent, as normalized (e.g. country=USA, state=NM, county=049)

applied_recipient_id.description: Normalized recipient hash and level sent

applied_recipient_location.description: Recipient location sent, as normalized (e.g. country=USA, state=WA)

applied_time_period_end.description: End date sent (YYYY-MM-DD), including a filled-in end

applied_time_period_start.description: Start date sent (YYYY-MM-DD), including a filled-in start

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_keyword`: An effective keyword has fewer than three characters. `invalid_naics_code`: An effective NAICS code is known to be invalid. `invalid_recipient_id`: An active analytics recipient_id is malformed. `invalid_location`: filters.place_of_performance_location or filters.recipient_location names an unknown US state, a county without a state or under an armed-forces code, a county or FIPS-number state under a non-USA country, or parts that place it in different states. `api_unavailable`: USAspending.gov API is unreachable or returns an error. `api_timeout`: USAspending.gov did not respond before the request deadline elapsed. `date_range_inverted`: Both filters.time_period_start and filters.time_period_end were supplied and the start falls after the end. `date_before_earliest`: The resolved start date precedes the 2007-10-01 earliest date this endpoint can search. `assistance_listings_type_mismatch`: filters.assistance_listings was given while every code in filters.award_type_codes is a contract or IDV code. `psc_codes_type_mismatch`: filters.psc_codes was given while every code in filters.award_type_codes is an assistance code. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

limitClamp.description: Present when a count input above its per-call cap was reduced to the cap.

applied.description: Value the call used: the per-call cap

notice.description: Names a limit reduced to the per-call maximum, a date bound that was filled in because only the other was supplied, and — when results are empty — any Assistance Listing, PSC, or DEF codes, recipient_id, and locations sent, with how to broaden filters. Absent when none applies.

results.description: Top items in this category by obligation amount

items.description: Category item with code, name, and obligation amount

agency_slug.description: Agency slug (awarding_agency, awarding_subagency, funding_agency, funding_subagency rows; on a subagency row, its parent department's) — pass to usaspending_get_agency as agency_slug. Absent when upstream has none.

code.description: Code value: NAICS, PSC, agency code, CFDA number, recipient DUNS, federal account code (AGENCY-MAIN, e.g. 047-4534), or DEF code (e.g. Z)

id.description: Item identifier (varies by category); absent on recipient_duns and defc rows

recipient_id.description: Recipient hash ID (recipient_duns rows) — pass to usaspending_get_recipient for the profile. Absent when upstream has none.

uei.description: Recipient Unique Entity Identifier (recipient_duns rows). Absent when upstream has none.

totalCount.description: Total number of items in this category (when available)

title: Spending by Category
